notes:
Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.27.4:

- Endpoint Agent Analysis (Step 6) now has two tabs and appears for DSPM / Classification scope too. The F1E Agent tab keeps the existing DLP Endpoint Status Log import; a new DSPM + FDC Agent tab imports the Data Classification 'Agent Management' CSV export.
- The DSPM + FDC analysis surfaces agent version distribution (with latest/outdated flags), online vs offline counts, operating-system and domain spread, stale hosts (not seen in 30+ days), unique host count and a per-host table (OS, version, status, last seen, IP).
- Both agent analyses are saved per HC session.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
